verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates a fixed set of third-party agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) inside its workspaces, with per-organization connection configuration and bring-your-own subscriptions. Its hosted MCP server and API also let outside agent clients like ChatGPT and Claude drive workspaces. However, there is no evidence of an open partner ecosystem, marketplace, or plugin mechanism for adding arbitrary partner-built agent apps; users have had to request support for additional agents and custom tools. Missing for 10: extensible plugin/marketplace for partner-built agents, documented process for adding arbitrary third-party agents, independent corroboration of these integrations in team workflows.
